requirement: The SDK checks for outstanding searches before invoking Habeas's rationale vetting. A submission rejected for an outstanding search MUST leave the rationale correction attempt available under {cite}`requirements.authoring.line_numbers.rejection`.
rationale:
The requirement has two obligations. The SDK checks for outstanding searches before Habeas's rationale vetting. A submission rejected for an outstanding search leaves the rationale correction attempt available.

`tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[outstanding_search_preserves_the_rationale_correction_attempt]` is marked `{test}` for the subject. It covers both obligations:

1. The model calls `search_text` and then submits a rationale containing a file-and-line citation while the search is still unfinished. The assertion `last_tool_response(2).contains("finish_search")` shows the rejection was for the outstanding search. If vetting ran first, the line-number message would appear instead. This also covers the ordering obligation.
2. The model then finishes the search and resubmits the same cited rationale. The test asserts that `last_tool_response(4)` contains the line-number rejection text, the location guidance taken from `judgment_rules`, the quoted citation and a UUID. So the line-number rejection still fired as the first such rejection. The earlier outstanding-search rejection therefore did not use up the correction attempt. If it had, the second submission would have been accepted, the run would have ended, and these assertions would have failed.
3. A final clean submission succeeds. The test asserts the determination is "true", there were 5 provider attempts and `submit_result` was called 3 times. This confirms the full sequence: outstanding-search rejection, line-number rejection, then acceptance.

The subject cites `requirements.authoring.line_numbers.rejection` as context. Its details are applied in this scenario: the quoted text, the guidance and the UUID. I did not reassess them beyond that. No obligation in the subject lacks a test, and there are no acknowledgments.

text: The SDK checks for outstanding searches before invoking Habeas's rationale vetting. A submission rejected for an outstanding search MUST leave the rationale correction attempt available under {cite}`requirements.authoring.line_numbers.rejection`.
For requirement, example, and site reviews, when the only submission in a response
under {cite}`requirements.authoring.submission` is otherwise valid but any of its
assessment's first such submission, and it passes the outstanding-search gate
harness MUST reject it instead of
accepting it and continue the conversation. The tool result MUST quote the
matched text, identify the affected rationale (including its correction position
for `Failed`), repeat the location guidance of
{cite}`requirements.authoring.judgment_rules`, and give a fresh random UUID,
saying the model may submit once more, either without line numbers or with
the offending rationale set to exactly that UUID to keep the rejected submission as it was.
A rejection MUST be counted in usage like any other turn.
